rows.failed_obligation: A representation of an odd number may use any positive odd number of copies of the odd generator, not exactly one.
rows.minimal_repair_direction: Introduce the odd multiplicity r of 2^n−1 and rule out every possible odd r, using a strengthened induction or an appropriate residue/Apéry-set lemma.
